messages:
felix: quick copy review for the Dedicated pools empty state in Console. PM says users new to Dedicated often don't know when to choose Dedicated vs Hosted. current CTA just says `Create pool` which is a bit ambiguous. want to make it clearer and suggest scenarios.

maya: agreed. empty state should educate without overwhelming. propose a short one-liner explaining when Dedicated is recommended + two CTAs: primary `Create Dedicated pool` and secondary `Learn about deployment options`.

pj: thumbs up. also add a tiny bullet list (2 items) under the line with examples: `High throughput production workloads` and `Data residency or strict isolation requirements`. keep bullets short.

arun: engineering note: the empty state component supports a short description (one line), an optional supporting list (max 3 items), and two buttons. we should keep the wording concise to avoid layout wrapping on narrow consoles.

maya: tone guidance: be confident and neutral. avoid words like "private" that could be confused with Private deployment product. prefer `Dedicated capacity` phrasing. also add an inline link to pricing and SLA for users who need commitments.

felix: copy proposals:
Primary heading (H2): `Dedicated capacity for predictable inference`
Lead line: `Reserve GPU capacity for steady, production traffic with predictable latency and costs.`
Bullets (2): `High-throughput production workloads`, `Data isolation and compliance needs`
Primary CTA: `Create Dedicated pool`
Secondary CTA (muted): `Compare deployment options`

pj: small accessibility nit: screen readers prefer the lead line to be readable as a single sentence. avoid mid-line parentheses. and make sure the primary CTA has aria-describedby pointing to the bullets list id so SR users get the context.

arun: can we include a short microcopy hint under the primary CTA for new accounts: `Free trial credits available` only when trial_eligible=true. conditional copy is supported. engineering asks for the exact string to toggle.

maya: suggested hint: `Free trial credits available — try Dedicated risk-free.` keep it short. and for enterprise accounts we show `Contact sales for SLA-backed capacity` as an alternative hint.

felix: alt text for the illustrative empty-state image? design-bot suggested we include it. suggested alt: `Illustration: server racks and a shield representing dedicated GPU capacity and isolation.` keep it descriptive but short.

design-bot: final compact copy package (engineer-ready, single-line fields):
Heading: "Dedicated capacity for predictable inference"
Lead: "Reserve GPU capacity for steady production traffic with predictable latency and cost."
Bullets: "High-throughput production workloads","Data isolation and compliance needs"
Primary CTA: "Create Dedicated pool"
Secondary CTA: "Compare deployment options"
Trial hint (conditional): "Free trial credits available — try Dedicated risk-free."
Enterprise hint (conditional): "Contact sales for SLA-backed capacity."
Image alt: "Illustration of server racks and a shield representing dedicated GPU capacity and isolation."
SR announcement: "Empty state: Dedicated capacity for predictable inference. Reserve GPU capacity for steady production traffic. Options: high-throughput workloads; data isolation and compliance."

maya: LGTM. devs, please ensure bullets are rendered as a single accessible list and the trial hint only shows when the user is eligible. add a small `i` tooltip linking to pricing when the user hovers the CTA.

arun: noted. will wire the conditional flags and aria attributes. will ping when deployed so we can usability-test with a couple of new signups.

felix: thanks team — i'll add these strings to the copy doc and update the mock. :white_check_mark:
